description: A small chapel/shrine structure from the Moss Ruins datapack — a single mossy stone-brick room with a doorway and a modest roof. Palette-clean and native-valid; audits cleanly at 1.21.11.

style_fit.rationale: Audits clean and would import without trouble, but it is small and plain — a single unremarkable room with no hero silhouette. This run's demand sheet needs hero-scale set-pieces, which it fills none of. Parked as a possible future room/corridor-tileset filler, not admitted now.
